bounded_contexts.name: cloud-compute
bounded_contexts.description: Code-backed Cloud Compute local foundation for provider-neutral VM, managed Kubernetes, and function metadata invariants plus tenant/cell workload identity, runtime isolation, scheduling, and audit-evidence guardrail. Capability-colocated docs/contracts live under k8s/ (formerly microservices/cloud-k8s); CS-CLOUD-COMPUTE-001 does not implement live Kubernetes bootstrap, EKS, OKE, EC2, OCI Compute, Lambda, service mesh, CNI, REST server, SDK, worker, OpenTofu plan/apply, measured SLO, active-active DR, provider-live smoke, or audit-chain persistence.

contracts.contract_status: root cloud-compute OpenAPI contracts are code-tested; service-local cloud-k8s contract files are compatibility/planning scaffolds and are not runtime-readiness evidence

slo_exemption.rationale: No current measured runtime SLI exists for this foundation, retired, or local-scaffold service; the manifest must not claim production or hyperscaler-ready SLO coverage until an OpenSLO file lands.

ips.title: Workload identity, runtime isolation, Kubernetes private/restricted/scheduling posture, audit evidence, and Cloud Compute manifest truth-down

hyperscaler_inv_coverage.circuit_breaker: not_claimed_cs_cloud_compute_001: no implemented runtime circuit-breaker, bulkhead, retry, scheduler controller, or provider operation evidence
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.tenant_rate_limit: not_claimed_cs_cloud_compute_001: no implemented per-tenant runtime quota/rate-limit enforcement beyond local metadata quota invariants
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.golden_signals: not_claimed_cs_cloud_compute_001: no implemented metrics/OpenSLO/golden-signal emission evidence
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.error_budget_burn: not_claimed_cs_cloud_compute_001: SLO list is empty because no measured Cloud Compute SLI or burn-rate rule is implemented yet

audit_chain.non_claim: CS-CLOUD-COMPUTE-001 records a multispectrum evidence bundle and audit-chain row only; it does not implement Cloud Compute runtime audit emission, Merkle sealing, or persistence.

secrets_substrate.non_claim: No raw cloud credential, kubeconfig, bearer token, private key, Lambda/EC2/OCI credential, or service-account secret is introduced or consumed by this local foundation. Evidence refs are validated as non-secret references only.

mesh_layering.non_claim: No live Cloud Compute pod, cluster, Envoy, Istio, Cilium policy, mesh policy, or network path is deployed by CS-CLOUD-COMPUTE-001.

compute_workload_guardrail.non_claim: Rust guardrails validate typed metadata only. They do not create clusters, launch VMs, execute functions, configure RuntimeClass, apply Pod Security Admission, attach IAM policies, or emit provider audit logs.

data_classification: PUBLIC metadata, INTERNAL_ONLY control-plane metadata, AUDIT evidence; function payload classes are policy labels only and no tenant payload processing is implemented by this ChangeSet

capacity_model.notes: CS-CLOUD-COMPUTE-001 is metadata/domain/API/adapter validation only. Runtime VM capacity, pod scheduling, function execution, autoscaling, telemetry, and SLOs remain explicit non-claims.

sharding_automation.non_claim: No scheduler shard split, node pool rebalance, cluster migration, tenant migration, or audit-chain persistence is implemented by CS-CLOUD-COMPUTE-001.

dr.non_claim: No live Cloud Compute replication, multi-region cluster, VM backup, function replication, warm standby, failover, restore drill, or DR measurement evidence is implemented by CS-CLOUD-COMPUTE-001.

pod_runtime_tier_justification: Cloud Compute is intended Tier-1 substrate because later runtime pods can schedule tenant workloads. CS-CLOUD-COMPUTE-001 has no runtime pod deployment; tier is retained as intended future isolation class only.

tenant_version_pinning.non_claim: Root OpenAPI contracts are code-tested for current API boundary behavior, but no per-tenant API version pinning runtime is implemented by CS-CLOUD-COMPUTE-001.

explicit_non_claims: No live Kubernetes cluster bootstrap, kubeadm, EKS, OKE, EC2, OCI Compute, Lambda, function execution runtime, CNI, CSI, service mesh, REST server, SDK, worker, OpenTofu plan/apply, provider-live smoke, measured SLO, capacity telemetry, DR, or audit-chain runtime persistence is implemented.
Legacy Markdown benchmark/parity/runbook/IP files under k8s/ remain planning/prose and are not readiness evidence for CS-CLOUD-COMPUTE-001.
The service-local cloud-k8s OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/proto files are compatibility scaffolds; root contracts/openapi/cloud/cloud-compute-*-v1.yaml files are the code-tested API evidence for this slice.
retirement_note: The kubeadm + containerd + Istio-Envoy on-prem stack codified by ADR-0121 was superseded by ADR-0375 (Talos + Cluster API + Argo CD fleet substrate). This microservice directory is retained read-only for compatibility; new on-prem substrate work targets infra/talos/installation-media + infra/capi.
